interpretation: Frozen held-out pilot; no powered confirmatory or physical-robot claim.
hypotheses: Earlier observable-state intervention can explain the reference gain over failure-only replanning.
Learned residual monitoring need not outperform simple postconditions or continuous replanning in this ideal-state testbed.
Candidate-completion memory may increase cost; task-outcome credit is a separately evaluated alternative.
primary_outcomes: paired capped action cost (executed actions on success; 24 on failure)
secondary_outcomes: completion curve for reporting cutoffs 1 through 24
alarm sources and historical onset-window matching
sampling_unit: Crossed model-training seed and complete history; repetitions and conditions remain within each history.
replication_rationale: Resource-bounded pilot with five training seeds and fourteen counterbalanced histories; compare development interval half-width with 0.25 action precision target, without changing final sample size or criteria.
condition_schedule: 14 Williams orders for seven conditions; base [0,1,6,2,5,3,4], cyclic relabelling then reversals.
memory_protocol: Cold online memories start empty per model/history; frozen memories fit on a separate root with the same order and never update during evaluation. Cold versus frozen also changes prior experience.
task_memory_reward: terminal task success / (1 + executed actions since candidate selection); update at episode end, including interrupted candidates.
